comment: Release-label gate (launch audit XR-LAUNCH-010, owner decision D2, 2026-10-22). XR is labelled "Public beta" until every gate below is "green". `bun run claim-lint` refuses identity.stability = "stable" while any gate is not green, and refuses stable-production wording ("Status: Stable", "production-ready", "generally available") on public surfaces while the label is not stable. A gate turns green only with evidence (CI run URL, hardware report or re-audit verdict) in its `evidence` field. Statuses: open | in-progress | fixed-unverified | green.

gates.title: One canonical public version on every claimed channel
gates.evidence: Phase 1 commit 80007d7f; channel:live 2026-10-22: github-releases, homebrew, winget fail (owner actions pending); hardening 2026-11-21 (HARDENING_LOG.md): Channel Live still red on main (runs 44898171263, 44902873750), NEW-11: the retired npm versions 3.0.0-3.1.5 carry deprecation messages that point to @beta, not @latest (owner: bun run npm:ghosts -- --print-commands); the other claimed channels could not be checked from the hardening sandbox

gates.title: Release gates are blocking, green and test reality
gates.evidence: Phase 3: 6 aggregate gate checks (.github/required-checks.json, owner applies branch protection), no-retry + quarantine policy, ci:policy, release publish needs journey + supply-chain, report-only workflows renamed (non-gating) and fixed to complete. Needs 10 consecutive green main runs; hardening 2026-11-21 (HARDENING_LOG.md): all six required checks green on every phase head of PR #215; 3 consecutive green main runs: 23090ee (CI 44898171204), 4ea49e2 (CI 44902873796), 1397292 (CI 44906486932), 3 of the 10 this gate needs; the main ruleset enforces 4 of the 6 checks declared in .github/required-checks.json (owner action)
